name: gap_exhaustion_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, gap openings (>0.5%) trigger 10-30 minutes of sustained directional participation — momentum algos, retail FOMO, and index arbitrage all push the index to successive new session extremes. As this absorption process nears completion, each new extreme is made on shrinking 5-second volume: the institutional buyers (gap-up) or sellers (gap-down) have been absorbed and remaining order flow is retail noise. When MFI(3-min) reaches extreme levels (>72 or <28) AND 5-second volume falls below the session average while price is at or near the session extreme, the exhaustion is confirmed. VWAP-benchmarked funds and short-gamma market-makers then initiate counter-trend flow — they are now getting fills significantly better than their benchmark, which accelerates the reversal.

indicators.name: gap_pct
indicators.purpose: Session-level attribute derived from day boundary. No scaling needed — same time concept regardless of bar size.

indicators.name: session_high / session_low
indicators.formula: running max(high) / min(low) from session open within each day_id
indicators.purpose: Cumulative measure — tracks the full gap extension from session open. No lookback period; tracks since bar 0 of each day.

indicators.name: vol_ma_36
indicators.purpose: 36 bars = 3 minutes of baseline volume. This is the smoothed 'normal' volume rate at 5-second frequency. We use 3 minutes rather than the original 14-minute MFI window because at 5s we want a baseline that reflects the current session momentum state, not the full morning session. A 14-min baseline at 5s (168 bars) would include the high-volume open itself, inflating the baseline artificially.

indicators.name: vol_ma_6
indicators.purpose: 6 bars = 30 seconds of recent volume. Compared against vol_ma_36 to detect real-time volume exhaustion at new extremes. Short window because we need immediate detection, not a lagging indicator.

indicators.name: mfi_36
indicators.purpose: Money Flow Index over 36 bars (3 minutes). Original used MFI(14) on 1-min bars = 14 minutes. Scaled to 36 bars (3 min) because we trade 15-120s holds — a 14-min MFI on 5s bars would be 168 bars (too slow to respond within the 09:25-11:00 exhaustion window). 3 minutes gives an MFI that reflects the current flow state without lagging behind the exhaustion signal.

indicators.name: rsi_24
indicators.purpose: RSI over 24 bars (2 minutes). Original used RSI(10) on 1-min bars = 10 minutes. At 5s resolution, 24 bars (2 min) is the appropriate trigger lookback — it's fast enough to confirm overbought/oversold conditions at the exhaustion point while holding 15-120 seconds. A 10-min RSI at 5s (120 bars) would not distinguish intraday exhaustion from the broader session trend.

indicators.name: near_extreme
indicators.formula: True if (gap_pct>0 and close >= session_high * (1 - near_pct)) OR (gap_pct<0 and close <= session_low * (1 + near_pct))
indicators.purpose: Checks if price is currently at or near the session extreme. Uses a tunable proximity threshold (default 0.12%) because at 5-second bars the exact extreme bar is noisy — the exhaustion pattern spans several bars near the high/low.

conditions: vol_ma_6 < vol_ma_36 * vol_ratio (recent volume < baseline, default vol_ratio=0.72)
buy_ce.confirmation: All conditions true simultaneously on same 5-second bar

conditions: vol_ma_6 < vol_ma_36 * vol_ratio (recent volume < baseline, default vol_ratio=0.72)
buy_pe.confirmation: All conditions true simultaneously on same 5-second bar

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option points corresponds to ~8 spot points adverse move at delta 0.5. If NIFTY extends the gap by 8 more spot points after entry, there is fresh buying/selling arriving — the exhaustion thesis is invalid and we exit immediately. NIFTY gap-day extensions rarely exceed 15-20 spot points from the exhaustion entry level if the reversal is genuine.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option points = ~14 spot point reversion at delta 0.5. NIFTY's first reversal leg after gap exhaustion typically spans 15-25 spot points within 30-120 seconds (VWAP algorithms and short-gamma market-makers provide immediate counter-flow). Capturing 14 pts (56-93% of expected move) at 1:1.75 R:R is the appropriate calibration.
exit.eod_rule: flatten at 11:00 IST (no new entries after 11:00; open positions closed at 15:25)

filters.vix_filter: India VIX between 12 and 22 — gaps need sufficient volatility to exhaust (VIX>12) but extreme VIX (>22) implies macro panic where gaps can run without exhausting
filters.time_filter: 09:25-11:00 IST only — before 09:25 the gap extension is still gathering momentum; after 11:00 natural volume decline creates false exhaustion signals indistinguishable from genuine ones
filters.volume_filter: vol_ma_6 < vol_ma_36 * vol_ratio — ensures declining volume at extremes, not just random low-volume bars
filters.trend_filter: gap_pct threshold (default 0.5%) ensures only meaningful gaps are traded; micro-gaps of 0.1-0.3% lack the momentum-exhaustion dynamic
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close prices

edge.edge_decay_risk: moderate — if index structure changes (e.g., circuit breakers, SEBI gap rules), the exhaustion timing shifts. Also degrades if too many participants adopt the same exhaustion detection logic.

adaptation_notes: Original strategy traded individual NIFTY50 constituent stocks (universe of equities). For index adaptation: (1) Universe collapses from 50 stocks to single NIFTY index — gap_pct now measured on the index itself, not per-stock; (2) Volume-at-extreme tracking simplified from 'track volume at each exact new-extreme bar' to 'compare rolling 30s volume to 3-min baseline while near session extreme' — this is more robust at 5-second index frequency where individual bar volumes are noisy; (3) MFI period scaled from 14-min (MFI14 on 1-min bars) to 3-min (MFI36 on 5s bars) because we hold 15-120s and need responsive signals; (4) RSI period scaled from 10-min to 2-min for same reason; (5) Session window compressed to 09:25-11:00 from 09:30-11:00 (no meaningfully different) — original 09:30 start kept in spirit; (6) MFI/RSI thresholds loosened slightly (original: MFI<25, RSI unspecified; converted: MFI<28/MFI>72) to account for index being smoother than individual stocks.
weaknesses: On macro event days (RBI rate decision, budget, election results), NIFTY gaps can run for 1-2 hours without exhausting — the first apparent exhaustion signal at 09:45 leads into a continuation move
5-second volume on NIFTY index is noisy; vol_ma_6 (30s window) can spuriously dip below vol_ma_36 during brief algo pauses even on strong trend days
Strategy fires only on gap days with gap > 0.5% — this is perhaps 25-40% of trading days, limiting the number of signals per month

_source.original_target: session VWAP OR 60% of gap-to-extreme range
